items.title: Mat Domber interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: I don’t play John Coltrane tunes.

ctx.x: Well — you will turn the tables on me and start interviewing me — but as a working musician I can tell you when I go out to play a jazz gig, if people hire me to play a jazz gig, not necessarily in a club but at a party or something, I don’t play John Coltrane tunes. I play the American Songbook. And that’s what people want to hear.
They don’t come to the clubs to hear it, I’ll tell you that.
